diseases.name: Anthracnose Fruit Rot
diseases.description: A fungal disease of strawberry that rots the fruit and can attack runners and crowns.
diseases.causes: Spores come in on infected transplants and spread by rain splash and overhead watering in warm weather.
symptoms: Round, sunken, tan to dark brown spots on the fruit
Orange-pink spore masses in the spots in wet weather
Fruit dries into a dark mummy
diseases.effect: Infected fruit is lost, sometimes most of a picking.
diseases.untreated: The fungus builds up in the planting and on mummies.

steps.title: Remove infected fruit
steps.instruction: Pick off and remove spotted fruit at every picking.
steps.rationale: Spores splash from them to healthy fruit.

steps.title: Protective fungicide in wet weather
steps.instruction: Spray a registered product following the label.

prevention.title: Use drip irrigation and straw mulch

lifecycle: The fungus arrives on infected transplants.
Rain and irrigation splash spores onto fruit.
Sunken spots with orange spore masses form.
